predecessors.name: Rhodesia
predecessors.text: 'Zimbabwe Rhodesia was preceded by another state named the Republic of Rhodesia'

successors.name: Republic of Zimbabwe
successors.text: 'On 18 April 1980, Zimbabwe Rhodesia became the independent Republic of Zimbabwe within the Commonwealth of Nations'

ledger.x: 1979: Zimbabwe Rhodesia returns to British rule.

wars.name: Rhodesian Bush War
wars.outcome: Negotiated end: Lancaster House talks in December 1979, a ceasefire announced on 21 December 1979, elections under British supervision in early 1980 and independence on 18 April 1980.

certainty.note: The frontiers are the colonial and Rhodesian lines of the predecessor; neither page opened discusses them.
